shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side. A woman in a purple shirt in the shelf-side window seat claims she can solve any riddle, with a woman in a red shirt in the doorway-side window seat and a man in a green shirt in the shelf-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The woman in a red shirt in the doorway-side window seat exchanges seats with the woman in a purple shirt in the shelf-side window seat and asks whether saying what one means is the same rule as meaning what one says.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a purple shirt answers that the meaning is the same.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the shelving-unit end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the doorway, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.
